title: Mud on the Rug
lines: The sun is hot. Jon and Bev are on a rug.
A pup hops up. Mud is on its legs.
Mud dots are on top of the rug!
"Not on the rug, pup!" said Jon. Bev nods.
Bev pats the pup, and it hops up.
The pup is on a rug.
Jon and Bev tug the rug up.
The mud is not on the rug. Bev has the bun.
scoring_note: This passage says "is not". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "isn't" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
